name: react-example
description: Visual Canva-style authoring studio for SCORM 1.2 e-learning courses.
author: SCORM Canva

scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['dist','electron/dist','release']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p,{ recursive: true, force: true })"
